out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: FRIED CHICKEN WINGS AT 78-94F ON TRAYS STACKED IN MORE THAN ONE LAYER IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE COOKED WINGS AT PLACED IN SINGLE LAYER ON TRAYS FOR COOLING. MONITOR TEMPERATURES CLOSELY TO ENSURE COOLING PARAMETERS ARE MET: 135F TO 70F IN 2 HOURS AND A FURTHER 41F IN A TOTAL OF 6 HOURS. BUFFALO WING FACTORY (Inspection Date: 04/24/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens, Prohibited Storage Areas
violations.observation: Clean equipment/utensils were found stored ON CHEMICAL STORAGE RACK NEAR DISHWASHING MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned and sanitized equipment, utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items may not be stored in: 1) locker rooms, 2) toilet rooms, 3) garbage rooms, 4) mechanical rooms, 5) under sewer lines that are not shielded to intercept potential drips, 6) under leaking water lines including leaking automatic fire sprinkler heads or under lines on which water has condensed, 7) under open stairwells, or 8) under other sources of contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REMOVED UTENSILS TO BE REWASHED AND SANITIZED. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEE COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: The squeeze bottle for water, oil , spice shakers on the tray next to the stove were observed without a label.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Discussed with manager who will label the food containers. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. BUFFALO WING FACTORY (Inspection Date: 10/30/2024) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored in Packaging
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: Single service take away boxes were observed stored facing up and unprotected at the shelf above the microwave and on the shelf above the drinks machine.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Discussed with the manager who inverted the containers to avoid contamination. Single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location that is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. In addition, the single-service items shall be kept in the original protective package or stored by using other means that afford protection from contamination until used.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: An air gap between the water supply outlet and the flood rim level @bar area 3 VAT sink is not observed.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Discussed with manager who will call a licensed plumber to correct this within 10 days. An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch.
